title: Numbers and Math — Level 10 — Final challenge

items.prompt: Dina writes sums in her book. Which sum is correct?
Rafi writes 40 in words. Which spelling is correct?
items.reteach: 40 ditulis forty, tanpa huruf u. Fourteen adalah 14.

items.prompt: Which sentence about nineteen is correct?

visual.text: Nineteen is one less than twenty.

choices.say: Nineteen is one less than twenty.

visual.text: Nineteen is one more than twenty.

choices.say: Nineteen is one more than twenty.

visual.text: Nineteen is the same as ninety.

choices.say: Nineteen is the same as ninety.

items.prompt: "A week has eight days." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Satu minggu ada tujuh hari: A week has seven days.

items.prompt: "Twelve minus five is eight." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: 12 − 5 = 7. Kalimat yang tepat: Twelve minus five is seven.

items.prompt: Which spelling of 12 is correct?
Which sentence about thirty and thirteen is correct?

visual.text: Thirty and thirteen are the same.

choices.say: Thirty and thirteen are the same.

items.reteach: Thirty = 30 dan thirteen = 13. Jadi 30 lebih besar dari 13.

items.prompt: Budi counts by twos: "two, four, six, nine." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Loncat dua: two, four, six, eight. Jadi nine kurang tepat, seharusnya eight.

items.prompt: Which spelling of 90 is correct?
items.reteach: 90 ditulis ninety: nine + ty. Nineteen adalah 19.

items.prompt: "Ten plus ten is twenty, and twenty plus ten is forty." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
Which sentence about money is correct?

visual.text: Five hundred plus five hundred is one thousand.

choices.say: Five hundred plus five hundred is one thousand.

visual.text: Five hundred plus five hundred is six hundred.

choices.say: Five hundred plus five hundred is six hundred.

visual.text: Five hundred plus five hundred is ten thousand.

choices.say: Five hundred plus five hundred is ten thousand.

visual.text: Five hundred plus five hundred is fifty.

choices.say: Five hundred plus five hundred is fifty.

items.prompt: Which sentence about one hundred is correct?

visual.text: One hundred comes right after ninety-nine.

choices.say: One hundred comes right after ninety-nine.

visual.text: One hundred comes right after ninety.

choices.say: One hundred comes right after ninety.

visual.text: One hundred comes right before ninety-nine.

choices.say: One hundred comes right before ninety-nine.

visual.text: One hundred comes right after nineteen.

choices.say: One hundred comes right after nineteen.

items.reteach: Urutannya 98, 99, 100. Jadi one hundred tepat sesudah ninety-nine.

items.prompt: How many oranges are there in Mother's basket?
Which fruit has the biggest number in Mother's basket?
How many apples and mangoes are there in the basket altogether?
How many goats does Mr. Anwar have?

stimulus.text: Mr. Anwar has a farm in Malang. He has fifteen ducks and seven goats. Five ducks are white, and the other ducks are brown.

items.reteach: Teksnya: fifteen ducks and seven goats. Kambingnya 7 = seven.

items.prompt: How many brown ducks are there on Mr. Anwar's farm?

stimulus.text: Mr. Anwar has a farm in Malang. He has fifteen ducks and seven goats. Five ducks are white, and the other ducks are brown.

items.prompt: Where is Mr. Anwar's farm?

stimulus.text: Mr. Anwar has a farm in Malang. He has fifteen ducks and seven goats. Five ducks are white, and the other ducks are brown.

items.reteach: Kalimat pertama: Mr. Anwar has a farm in Malang.

items.prompt: Who reads the most books this month?
Which two children read the same number of books?
How many more books does Lala read than Doni?
How much is one juice on School Market Day?

stimulus.text: School Market Day. One cake: 2,000 rupiah. One juice: 3,000 rupiah. One sandwich: 5,000 rupiah.

items.reteach: One juice: 3,000 rupiah = three thousand rupiah.

items.prompt: Rina buys one cake and one sandwich on School Market Day. How much does she pay?

stimulus.text: School Market Day. One cake: 2,000 rupiah. One juice: 3,000 rupiah. One sandwich: 5,000 rupiah.

items.prompt: What is the cheapest thing on the School Market Day list?

stimulus.text: School Market Day. One cake: 2,000 rupiah. One juice: 3,000 rupiah. One sandwich: 5,000 rupiah.

items.reteach: Cheapest artinya paling murah. Cake hanya 2,000 rupiah.

items.prompt: At a market in Surabaya. Seller: "How many eggs do you want?" Mother: "One dozen, please." How many eggs does Mother want?
Teacher: "How old are you, Rio?" Rio: "I am seven. My brother is two years older." How old is Rio's brother?
Ani: "I have three pencils." Bayu: "I have double that." How many pencils does Bayu have?
Mother gives Lina twenty candies. Lina shares them equally with her sister. How many candies does each girl get?
items.reteach: Dibagi sama rata untuk 2 anak: 20 dibagi 2 = 10 = ten.

items.prompt: Shopkeeper: "That is four thousand rupiah." Ali gives five thousand rupiah. How much change does Ali get?
items.reteach: Change artinya uang kembalian. 5,000 − 4,000 = 1,000 = one thousand rupiah.

items.prompt: There are nine children on the bus. At the next stop, four children get off and six children get on. How many children are on the bus now?
items.reteach: Get off = turun, get on = naik. 9 − 4 = 5, lalu 5 + 6 = 11 = eleven.

items.prompt: Rudi's class plays football at the park. There are three teams. Each team has five players. How many players are there?
Mom: "Please buy two kilos of rice and one kilo of sugar." How many kilos does the child buy in all?
items.reteach: 2 kilo beras + 1 kilo gula = 3 kilo = three.

items.prompt: Grandma is sixty years old. Grandpa is five years older. How old is Grandpa?
Teacher: "Open your book to page twenty-nine." Which page does the class open?
Sinta has fifteen stickers. She gives six stickers to Tomi. Sinta says, "Now I have ___ stickers."
At a beach in Banyuwangi, Kiki finds eight shells. Her brother finds seven shells. How many shells do they find together?
Arrange from the smallest: thirty, thirteen, three, twenty.
Arrange from the biggest: sixty, sixteen, six, sixty-one.
Change into words: 47
Change into numbers: eighty-three
Arrange the words to make a correct sentence: is / plus / two / six / eight
items.reteach: Pola kalimat: angka + plus + angka + is + hasil. Six plus two is eight.

items.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as 5 + 4 = 9?
items.reteach: Tanda + dibaca plus, tanda = dibaca equals.

items.prompt: Write 12 − 7 = 5 in words.
items.reteach: Tanda − dibaca minus. 12 = twelve, 7 = seven, 5 = five.

items.prompt: Arrange to count by tens: fifty, twenty, forty, thirty.
Change into numbers: one hundred
Arrange from the smallest: ninety, nineteen, nine, ninety-nine.
How do we read Rp15.000 in English?
items.reteach: 15.000 dibaca fifteen thousand. Fifty thousand adalah 50.000.

items.prompt: Change into words: the 2nd day
items.reteach: 2nd dibaca second (kedua). Urutan: first, second, third.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am a number. If you add three to me, you get ten. What number am I?
Which one is the odd one out? two, four, seven, eight
items.reteach: Two, four, eight adalah bilangan genap. Seven ganjil, jadi berbeda sendiri.

items.prompt: Look at the pattern: one, two, four, eight, ___
items.reteach: Setiap angka menjadi double: 1, 2, 4, 8, lalu 16 = sixteen.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am between ten and twenty. I am two tens minus one. What number am I?
Letter code: A = 1, B = 2, C = 3. What is the total of the word CAB?
Ana is eight. Ben is three years younger than Ana. Cici is two years older than Ben. How old is Cici?
Which number word has the most letters? six, ten, seven, two
items.reteach: Seven punya 5 huruf. Six, ten, two hanya 3 huruf.

items.prompt: A hen has two legs. A goat has four legs. How many legs do one hen and two goats have?
Ten birds sit on a tree. Three birds fly away. Then two birds come back. How many birds are on the tree now?
Odd one out: twenty, thirty, fourteen, fifty
items.reteach: Twenty, thirty, fifty adalah puluhan (-ty). Fourteen berakhiran -teen.

items.prompt: Word pattern: two makes twenty, three makes thirty, five makes …
Riddle: I am a number word with four letters. I am more than three and less than five. What am I?
items.reteach: Lebih dari 3 dan kurang dari 5 adalah 4: four (4 huruf).
